question: Which of the following is NOT true regarding the antioxidants?

options.text: It prevents the damage of cellular functions.
It helps in the repair of cellular functions.
Animal products are the chief source of antioxidants.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Animal products are the chief source of antioxidants.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The statement that is NOT true regarding antioxidants is** "Animal products are the chief source of antioxidants". **
 
• **The primary source of antioxidants is **typically plant-based foods like fruits, vegetables, and nuts
 
• Antioxidants neutralize** free radicals, preventing damage to cellular function**s
 
• They are believed to **help delay the aging process by reducing oxidative stress. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Vitamin A, C, and E **are considered key dietary antioxidants. 
 
• **Vitamin A**:
 
 
• Vitamin A, in its a**ctive form as retinol, helps protect cells from damage caused by free radicals.**
 
• It plays a crucial role in maintaining healthy skin, vision, and immune function.
 
• It has** antioxidant properties that help in reducing oxidative stress**, which can contribute to chronic diseases and aging.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin C**:
 
 
• Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) is a** powerful water-soluble antioxidant that helps neutralize free radicals in the body.**
 
• It also helps regenerate other antioxidants and supports the immune system.
 
• Vitamin C is vital for the** synthesis of collagen (**important for skin health) and has been shown to protect against the damage caused by oxidative stress and inflammation.
 
 
 
• **Vitamin E**:
 
 
• Vitamin E, primarily in the form o**f alpha-tocopherol, **is a fat-soluble antioxidant that helps protect cell membranes from oxidative damage.
 
• It is particularly important for maintaining the health of the skin, eyes, and immune system.
 
• Vitamin E also plays a role in **preventing the oxidation of lipids (fats), which is crucial for preventing cardiovascular disease.**
